lines.translation: the lowest of the low, the worst of the worst.
I am poor, but I have the Wealth of Your Name, O my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ihu dhan saar hor bikhiaa chhaar ||4||
lines.translation: This is the most excellent wealth; all else is poison and ashes. ||4||
I pay no attention to slander and praise; I contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
I celebrate the One who blesses me with His Bounty.
Whomever You forgive, O Lord, is blessed with status and honor.
Says Nanak, I speak as He causes me to speak. ||5||12||
Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaaiaa mail vadhaaiaa paidhai ghar kee haan ||
lines.translation: Eating too much, one's filth only increases; wearing fancy clothes, one's home is disgraced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਕਿ ਬਕਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bak bak vaad chalaaiaa bin naavai bikh jaan ||1||
lines.translation: Talking too much, one only starts arguments. Without the Name, everything is poison - know this well. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਜਾਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa aisaa bikham jaal man vaasiaa ||
lines.translation: O Baba, such is the treacherous trap which has caught my mind;
riding out the waves of the storm, it will be enlightened by intuitive wisdom. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh khaanaa bikh bolanaa bikh kee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: They eat poison, speak poison and do poisonous deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jam dar baadhe maareeahi chhootas saachai naai ||2||
lines.translation: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are punished; they can be saved only through the True Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਵ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiv aaiaa tiv jaaisee keeaa likh lai jaai ||
lines.translation: As they come, they go. Their actions are recorded, and go along with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mool gavaaiaa daragah milai sajaai ||3||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh loses his capital, and is punished in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਖੋਟੌ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੌ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀਂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag khotau sach niramalau gurasabadee(n) veechaar ||
lines.translation: The world is false and polluted; only the True One is Pure. Contemplate Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: te nar virale jaaneeahi jin a(n)tar giaan muraar ||4||
lines.translation: Those who have God's spiritual wisdom within, are known to be very rare. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਨੀਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਅਮਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajar jarai neejhar jharai amar ana(n)d saroop ||
lines.translation: They endure the unendurable, and the Nectar of the Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss, trickles into them continuously.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਲ ਕੌ ਮੀਨੁ ਸੈ ਥੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jal kau meen sai the bhaavai raakhahu preet ||5||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the fish is in love with the water; if it pleases You, Lord, please enshrine such love within me. ||5||13||
Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
Songs, sounds, pleasures and clever tricks;
joy, love and the power to command;
fine clothes and food - these have no place in one's consciousness.
True intuitive peace and poise rest in the Naam. ||1||
What do I know about what God does?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਤਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa tan kichh na sukhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing makes my body feel good. ||1||Pause||
Yoga, thrills, delicious flavors and ecstasy;
wisdom, truth and love all come from devotion to the Lord of the Universe.
My own occupation is to work to praise the Lord.
Deep within, I dwell on the Lord of the sun and the moon. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: priu priu preet prem ur dhaaree ||
lines.translation: I have lovingly enshrined the love of my Beloved within my heart.
My Husband Lord, the Lord of the World, is the Master of the meek and the poor.
Night and day, the Naam is my giving in charity and fasting.
The waves have subsided, contemplating the essence of reality. ||3||
What power do I have to speak the Unspoken?
I worship You with devotion; You inspire me to do so.
You dwell deep within; my egotism is dispelled.
So whom should I serve? There is no other than You. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meethaa ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is utterly sweet and sublime.
Such is the Ambrosial Nectar I see deep within.
Those who taste this, attain the state of perfection.
O Nanak, they are satisfied, and their bodies are at peace. ||5||14||
Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਂਗਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar dekh sabad man maaniaa avar na raa(n)ganahaaraa ||
lines.translation: Deep within, I see the Shabad, the Word of God; my mind is pleased and appeased. Nothing else can touch and imbue me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis jeeaa dekh samaale tis hee kee sarakaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Day and night, God watches over and cares for His beings and creatures; He is the Ruler of all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਘਣੌ ਅਤਿ ਰੂੜੌ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh raa(n)g ghanau at rooRau ||
lines.translation: My God is dyed in the most beautiful and glorious color.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਰਸ ਲਾਲ ਸਗੂੜੌ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal preetam manamohan at ras laal sagooRau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Merciful to the meek and the poor, my Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; He is so very sweet, imbued with the deep crimson color of His Love. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: oopar koop gagan panihaaree a(n)mrit peevanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Well is high up in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Nectar flows, and I drink it in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis kee rachanaa so bidh jaanai guramukh giaan veechaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: The creation is His; He alone knows its ways and means. The Gurmukh contemplates spiritual wisdom. ||2||
